message: a lambda may not capture `x`, whose type `T` could be a context
fix: take it as a parameter of the lambda instead — the `fn(C, A) => B` shape a `*Ctx` combinator passes — or return the value rather than a closure over it
notes: a generic body is checked once, for every instantiation at once (SPEC 13.5), so a type parameter here stands for a context type too — and `fn wrap<T>(x: T, f: fn(T) => ()): fn() => ()` would otherwise launder one into a closure whose type mentions no effect at all
